ashok: Evening oncall — quick bridge snapshot. Nothing escalated to a SEV but two items to call out: an embed-store 502 spike earlier and eu-west GPU pool hitting burst caps. Mitigations applied, follow-ups listed below.

laura: Can you drop the incident links / short traces here?

ashok: Timeline: ~21:10-21:22 UTC we saw a surge of 502/503 from embed-proxy v4 when cache miss rate jumped. Root: upstream kv-store intermittently timing out under burst. Rolling restart of the embed-proxy deployment recovered error rate. Internal incident doc: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-115 (internal)

mike: What restart command did you run?

ashok: Ran a safe rollout restart: 
```
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/embed-proxy --timeout=2m
```
Also scaled cache nodes briefly and bumped autoscaler min to 3 for the cache group.

jess: OK. What are the concrete follow-ups for SRE/infra?

ashok: Follow-ups: 1) Add alert: cache miss-rate > 8% for 5m -> paging (investigate), 2) Increase kv-store health-check timeout from 1s -> 3s and add a retry layer, 3) Add a small playbook test that performs a controlled embed-proxy restart in staging and verifies no client 5xx. I'll open a PR with the alert + runbook.

laura: And eu-west GPU pool?

ashok: At ~22:35 UTC eu-west dedicated GPU pool hit its burst limit for a short window (heavy batch inference jobs plus synthetic tests). We changed routing policy to route low-priority / background requests to the burst pool and degraded them to a smaller quantized variant; this freed headroom for critical requests. No client-facing errors observed.

mike: Any risk of silent quality regressions from the fallback model?

ashok: We picked the small-quantized variant for only non-critical routes and added a sampling check of outputs (1% of requests go through primary model even while fallback applied). Also set 429-backoff headers so callers back off gracefully.

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: r-embed-proxy@v4.1.2 rolled at 21:24 UTC :white_check_mark:

jess: I'll take the alert PR — tag me @jess when you create it.

ashok: Tagged you on the PR. Quick operational ask: next shift please verify embed latency after 22:00. If you see p95 > 200ms for 3 consecutive 5m windows, escalate to #eng-sre and ping me.

mike: Copy that. I'll run the synthetic test suite at 22:05 and monitor p95.

laura: Adding restart steps and verification queries to the runbook now. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
